snippet.title: Gravitee Wars Demo Out NOW!
snippet.description:
The demo for Gravitee Wars is out now!

The demo contains a single-player story campaign that won't feature in the full game. Meet the team as they show off their ship in the popular GraviTV Ships tv show, and solve some issues before the next round of the Gravitee Wars Tournament.

Download Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4376520/Gravitee_Wars_Demo/
